title: Small Weapon Showcase for my game (3 weeks into development)
author: Psychological-Arm42
selftext:
Small showcase of the 5 finished weapons (Katana, Dual Swords, GreatSword, Shortbow, ChainedReaper) currently in my game, with full VFX and animations. 

3 weeks into development, Claude Opus 5.5 + Codex for the VFX. Non-boss enemies, UI and most of the world is using placeholder assets, will have a massive upgrade there. 

Kindly share your opinion. Do you like this? Would you have fun playing with these weapons? Which one looks the best? Thanks.

BTW, this is just one skill set (4 abilities, 4 more abilities are there for each weapon, configurable)
